caption:
A Rs 5,000 monthly SIP, shown as a simple illustration: at an assumed 10% a year (compounded monthly), it could grow to about Rs 10.3 lakh in 10 years, Rs 38.3 lakh in 20 years and Rs 1.14 crore in 30 years.
Invested amounts are Rs 6 lakh, Rs 12 lakh and Rs 18 lakh. This is an assumption, not a forecast; actual returns vary and can be negative.
The point: time, not timing, does much of the work.
How long could your longest SIP keep running?
